title.zh: 授予达沃省Babac市镇电灯、热力与动力系统特许经营权的法案
title.en: An Act Granting the Municipality of Babac, Province of Davao, a Franchise for an Electric Light, Heat and Power System
title.orig: An Act Granting the Municipality of Babac, Province of Davao, a Franchise for an Electric Light, Heat and Power System
title.vi: Đạo luật cấp quyền khai thác cho Municipality of Babac, Province of Davao để xây dựng, lắp đặt, vận hành và duy trì hệ thống điện tại thị xã Babac, tỉnh Davao
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติให้สัมปทานแก่ Municipality of Babac, Province of Davao เพื่อก่อสร้าง ติดตั้ง ดำเนินการ และบำรุงรักษาระบบไฟฟ้าในเทศบาล Babac, จังหวัด Davao
title.id: Undang-Undang memberikan waralaba kepada Municipality of Babac, Province of Davao untuk membangun, memasang, mengoperasikan, dan memelihara sistem tenaga listrik di Kotamadya Babac, Provinsi Davao
title.ms: Akta memberikan francais kepada Municipality of Babac, Province of Davao untuk membina, memasang, mengendalikan dan menyelenggara sistem tenaga elektrik di Perbandaran Babac, Wilayah Davao

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1959/ra_2322_1959.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Subject to the terms and conditions established in Act Numbered Thirty-six hundred thirty-six, as amended by Commonwealth Act Numbered One hundred thirty-two, and to the provisions of the Constitution, there is granted to the Municipality of Babac, Province of Davao, for a period of twenty-five years from the approval of this Act, the right, privilege and authority to construct, maintain and operate an electric light, heat and power system for the purpose of generating and distributing electric light heat and/or power for sale within the limits of said municipality.

In the event that the grantee shall purchase and secure from the National Power Corporation electric heat and power, the National Power Corporation is hereby authorized to negotiate and transact for the benefit and in behalf of the public consumers with reference to rates.

It is expressly provided that in the event the government should desire to maintain and operate for itself the system and enterprise herein authorized, the grantee shall surrender its franchise and will turn over to the government all serviceable equipment therein, at cost, less reasonable depreciation.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 19, 1959.
